four front bays as one coupled review unit
central keep and recessed honeycomb rose
upper lantern, shallow hero dome and crown
authored side bays and quiet rear apse

requiredConstruction: Trace exact-crop normalized landmarks first and fit the review camera. Geometry is not allowed to redefine those landmarks.

Form P0 from 10-12 hand-controlled noncircular spline cross-sections and loft/skin them into a broad stepped civic visual hull. Voxel-remesh into one watertight shell. Major massing may not use sphere, cylinder, cone, egg, gourd, onion, or box primitives.
Use turnaround v2 solely to constrain depth, side returns and rear apse. Reject its repeated-dome or mound tendencies where they conflict with the exact source.
Carve P2-P4 recesses into or deeply intersect them with the shell: portal tunnel, four bay cavities with side returns, and recessed rose. No facade backing plane, floating disk, or shallow badge.
The purple portal must be first contrast anchor, rose second. All four inhabited front bays must be instantly countable at 000, 045, 315, clay and phone views.
Create shallow segmented roofs from spline lofts, not dome primitives. Preserve one hero crown hierarchy and varied subordinate architecture.
Map bevelled P8 tracery curves onto the shell and bury 30-40 percent into the surface before join/merge. Ribs must wrap corners and rasterize at least 2-3 pixels thick at 390x844.
Use seven PBR families: wax stone, royal gold, dark bronze, occupied recess, amber glazing, purple enamel, and transmitted/clear-coated honey. Source pixels may never be baked or exported.
Create P10 from metaball/SDF volumes intersecting ledges: convex meniscus shelf, sagging curtain, fused ropes, beads and weighted drops. No cardboard sheet, awning, pipe, lamp or post silhouette.
Preserve semantic GLB nodes and constructionStage extras for the three-robot build and pop/flash commissioning sequence.

earlyBlockoutGate.scope: P0-P7 clay only; no tracery, honey, glazing or ornament
earlyBlockoutGate.instruction: Do not build P8-P11 or runtime integration unless an independent read-only early reviewer approves this gate. One bounded spline/camera correction is eligible only if every critical score is at least 0.50 and one measurable hypothesis explains the miss.

tooling.runtimeLoader: standard Three.js GLTFLoader using existing repo patterns

integrity: Every immutable packet is written renders-first/manifest-last, then independently hashes source, crop, turnaround, builder, blend, GLB, runtime when applicable, and every evidence image. Builder never self-approves.
